# Permissions and repacking

{% hint style="danger" %}
**Repacking, reuploading and redistribution of Simple Cinematics Plus are strictly prohibited. No permission is granted to anyone, for any reason.**
{% endhint %}

* Do not repack, merge, reupload, mirror or redistribute Simple Cinematics Plus, in whole or in part, including inside server packs or mod collections uploaded as new items.
* Do not edit, rebrand or reupload modified versions.
* This also applies to the required mods. Simple Cinematics, Dabs Framework, Community Framework and Community Online Tools have their own no-repack terms, so they must be loaded from their original Workshop pages.
* Servers must load Simple Cinematics Plus by subscribing to its Workshop item.

Any repacked or reuploaded copy is unauthorized and will be subject to DMCA.
